title: Легко сделать и трудно понять
description: Легко сделать и трудно понять: применяем правило в новых ситуациях, разбираем словарь, диалог и авторский текст без аудирования.
objectives: Описывать сложность действия без лишнего предлога
notes: После easy/difficult возможно to + глагол: The office is easy to find.
В этой модели не нужно for перед инфинитивом: difficult to read, не difficult for to read.

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

exercises.prompt: Выбери точный вариант: The map is easy ___ because the labels are large.
exercises.explanation: Easy to read описывает лёгкость чтения.

exercises.prompt: Вставь слово из пары: to / for.

public_payload.sentence: The entrance was difficult ___ find at night.

exercises.editorial_answer: The entrance was difficult to find at night.
exercises.explanation: В этой модели после difficult нужен to-infinitive.

exercises.editorial_answer: The instructions are easy to follow.
exercises.explanation: Easy to follow связывает качество инструкций с действием читателя.

exercises.prompt: Исправь ошибку в указанной конструкции, сохраняя остальные слова и смысл.

public_payload.sentence: The address is difficult for to find.

accepted: The address is difficult to find.

exercises.reference_answer: The address is difficult to find.
exercises.incorrect_answer: The address is difficult for to find.
exercises.editorial_answer: The address is difficult to find.

exercises.prompt: Почему основные здания было легко найти?

public_payload.passage: The visitors received a new map of the campus. The main buildings were easy to find because each had a large number. The sports entrance was more difficult to see: it was behind a low wall. The receptionist added a note to help visitors find it after dark.

options.label: Every entrance was behind a wall.
The campus had only one room.

exercises.prompt: Соедини слова с переводом в контексте урока.
exercises.editorial_answer: easy — лёгкий; difficult — трудный; clear — ясный; instructions — инструкции
exercises.explanation: В этих контекстах: easy — лёгкий; difficult — трудный; clear — ясный; instructions — инструкции.

public_payload.passage: The visitors received a new map of the campus. The main buildings were easy to find because each had a large number. The sports entrance was more difficult to see: it was behind a low wall. The receptionist added a note to help visitors find it after dark.

options.label: To close the sports centre permanently.
To help people find the sports entrance after dark.

exercises.editorial_answer: To help people find the sports entrance after dark.
exercises.explanation: Примечание адресовано конкретной сложности поиска входа.

options.label: Yes, it is easy for follow.
Yes, it is easy followed to.
Yes, it is easy to follow.

exercises.editorial_answer: Yes, it is easy to follow.
exercises.explanation: Easy to follow — естественное описание понятного руководства.

public_payload.sentence: A message that is simple to understand is ___.

exercises.explanation: Clear в таком контексте означает ясный и понятный.
